gloss: isolated place; an island on land

definitions.gloss: isolated place; place cut off from transport; an island on land
definitions.explanation: A place on land that is so poorly served by roads, railways or buses that it is as cut off as an island. Used of remote villages, and humorously of neighborhoods or campuses far from any station.

examples.japanese: {陸|りく}の{孤島|ことう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧。
examples.english: A village called an island on land.

examples.japanese: ⟦{大雪|おおゆき}→大雪：03017_ooyuki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{道路|どうろ}→道路：01481_douro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{止|と}まり→止まる：00555_tomaru⟧、⟦{町|まち}→町：00613_machi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{陸|りく}の{孤島|ことう}になった。
examples.english: Heavy snow closed the roads, and the town was completely cut off.

examples.japanese: うち⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大学|だいがく}→大学：00608_daigaku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{駅|えき}→駅：02180_eki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦バス→バス：00769_basu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{四十分|よんじゅっぷん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧、⟦まさに→まさに：00270_masani⟧{陸|りく}の{孤島|ことう}だ。
examples.english: Our university is forty minutes by bus from the station; it's a real island on land.

notes:
Literally "a lonely island on land": ⟦{陸|りく}→陸：03675_riku⟧ (land) + ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ + ⟦{孤島|ことう}→孤島：12240_kotou⟧ (solitary island).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {陸|りく}の{孤島|ことう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれる→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧: to be called an island on land
- {陸|りく}の{孤島|ことう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to be cut off (by a disaster or snow)
- {陸|りく}の{孤島|ことう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{化|か}す→化す：29802_kasu⟧: to turn into an isolated place (written)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{僻地|へきち}→僻地：17059_hekichi⟧: remote area (a neutral, official word)
- ⟦{孤立|こりつ}→孤立：12229_koritsu⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be isolated, cut off
